strengths.claim: The recording contains confirmed close-range or tactical exchanges that can be reviewed as complete episodes.
The player sometimes converts a visible advantage into a fast outcome.

weaknesses.claim: Some exchanges end in damage, retreat, or death after the player loses a safe position.
The extraction goal may be undermined when the player remains exposed after a bad first trade.

priorities.title: Create an exit before committing
priorities.behavior_to_change: Before taking a close fight, identify the nearest hard cover and route back toward the goal.
priorities.why_it_matters: A forced fight still has to preserve a way to survive and extract.
priorities.observed_consequence: The selected loss or escape events show damage, retreat, or death after exposure.
priorities.alternative: Move to the nearest hard cover, take the first safe exchange, then disengage if the path to a safe win disappears.

counterfactual.claim: This would likely preserve more options and reduce exposure; it cannot guarantee survival.
unknowns: Enemy aim, teammates, and unseen routes are unknown.

drill.name: Exit-first repetition drill
drill.success_condition: Before each forced fight, say or mark one cover point and one retreat direction before firing.

priorities.title: Stop sorting loot when danger appears
priorities.behavior_to_change: Cancel inventory or loot interaction immediately when a nearby enemy forces contact.
priorities.why_it_matters: extract_with_valuable_loot is lost when the player is stationary and cannot aim or move.
priorities.observed_consequence: At least one candidate event is a loot interruption or a fight near a loot route.
priorities.alternative: Break line of sight first, then heal or resume loot only after the area is safer.

counterfactual.claim: This would likely reduce the chance of taking free damage while vulnerable.
unknowns: The unseen enemy route is unknown.

drill.name: Loot-cancel drill
drill.success_condition: On any shot or damage cue during loot, leave the interface within one second.

priorities.title: Separate connected enemies
priorities.behavior_to_change: After the first target, move so the next enemy cannot inherit the same angle.
priorities.why_it_matters: A group fight becomes harder when every target can see the same lane.
priorities.observed_consequence: Connected cluster events show multiple targets or pressure through linked positions.
priorities.alternative: Use smoke, height, or a corner to shorten the next line of sight before re-peeking.

counterfactual.claim: This would likely make target order safer while keeping the fight forced.
unknowns: Enemy coordination and hidden angles are unknown.

drill.name: One-target lane drill
drill.success_condition: After each down, change cover or angle before exposing to the next target.

learning_objectives.title: Protect the extraction route
learning_objectives.opening_line: We will judge every decision by whether it keeps the loot route alive.
learning_objectives.question_for_player: Where is the safest reset before you take the next shot?
learning_objectives.reveal: The map should show the first cover and the visible consequence of staying exposed.
learning_objectives.drill: Mark an exit before every forced fight.

learning_objectives.title: Win forced close fights without chasing
learning_objectives.opening_line: When the enemy comes close, commit quickly—but do not turn a forced fight into an optional chase.
learning_objectives.question_for_player: Is the enemy threatening your position, or are you opening a fight that can be left alone?
learning_objectives.reveal: The review separates forced danger from optional contact.
learning_objectives.drill: Call forced or optional before firing.

learning_objectives.title: Improve movement and aim under pressure
learning_objectives.opening_line: We will connect aim quality to the position that gave it time to work.
learning_objectives.question_for_player: What cover lets your crosshair stay ready while your body is harder to hit?
learning_objectives.reveal: The freeze frame names one cover point and one crosshair height.
learning_objectives.drill: Move to cover before healing or reloading after damage.
